title: Patrick Stewart dies – level 3
paragraphs: Tributes have poured in from around the world following the death of renowned British actor Sir Patrick Stewart at the age of 86. His close friend and co-star Sir Ian McKellen praised him as one of the most respected actors of his generation.

Stewart built a legendary career that seamlessly bridged classical Shakespearean theater and massive Hollywood blockbusters. Although he earned international fame playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek and Professor Charles Xavier in X-Men, he always remained deeply connected to his stage roots at the Royal Shakespeare Company.

Directors and fellow actors remembered him as a generous collaborator who brought immense humanity, discipline, and accessibility to every role he played, and his passing marks a huge loss for stage and screen. His final film performance will serve as a lasting farewell to fans worldwide.
